task_completion.description: The agent has imported the flu_1978.csv data into GeoGebra, visible as a list of points or a spreadsheet.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for a set of data points plotted on the graph or values in the GeoGebra spreadsheet view corresponding to the 1978 flu data.

task_completion.description: The SIR differential equations or a numerical approximation (like SolveODE) are defined in the Algebra view using N=763.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Check the Algebra sidebar for equations involving S', I', R' or a SolveODE command referencing beta, gamma, and the initial conditions S=762, I=1.

task_completion.description: Sliders or input boxes for beta and gamma are present and being adjusted.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for sliders labeled 'beta' and 'gamma' (or similar) in the Algebra or Graphics view.

task_completion.description: The infected (I) curve is plotted and visually aligned with the imported data points.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A continuous curve (representing I) should pass through or near the scatter plot of the observed flu cases.

task_completion.description: The final values for beta and gamma are within the acceptable range of the target values.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Check the Algebra view for final values: beta should be approximately 1.66 (±0.25) and gamma should be approximately 0.44 (±0.07).

task_completion.description: The project is saved as 'sir_analysis.ggb' in the specified directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for the 'Save' dialog box or the filename 'sir_analysis.ggb' in the GeoGebra window title bar.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the GeoGebra GUI rather than just using the terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots should show the mouse cursor interacting with GeoGebra menus, sliders, or the input bar.

integrity.description: The agent derived the parameters through calibration rather than typing them in immediately.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory should show the curve moving and changing shape as sliders are adjusted before settling on the final values.

integrity.description: The agent used the actual GeoGebra application interface.
integrity.visual_evidence: The standard GeoGebra layout (Algebra view, Graphics view, Input bar) must be visible.
